turns.text: Thanks for calling Northstar Wireless, this is Amy. How can I help you today?
Honestly, I'm pretty annoyed. I'm going to India next month for 10 days. Do I need a day pass?
I completely understand your frustration, and I'm sorry for the trouble. I can help with that. First, can you give me the phone number on the account and your four-digit account PIN?
Thanks. And your four-digit account PIN?

Thank you, Tyler, you're verified. I see you're on Unlimited Plus. Roaming in India isn't included on your plan. The Asia-Pacific and South America day pass is $15.00 per day, so 10 days would be $150.00. It only charges on days you use your phone there. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Are you kidding me? I pay for this every month.
I completely understand your frustration, and I'm sorry for the trouble. If you'd like a specialist, just let me know. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
I want to speak to a supervisor.
Of course. I'm transferring you to a specialist now. Please hold.
